bio: Although its immediate setting may lack charm, the position of this restaurant facing the marina is delightful, with its superb sea views through its picture windows. The delicious, authentic and carefully prepared cuisine focuses on fish and seafood “straight from the sea to your plate”. Although there is an à la carte, ingredients are often subject to availability. Seafood, rock fish and pasta served with an array of original sauces are just some of the delicious classic dishes on the menu....
